in_marathi.name: Sharvardhan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Shiva's Abode
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvardhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharvardhan is a compound name consisting of 'Shar' and 'Vardhan'. 'Shar' means 'mountain' and 'Vardhan' means 'Lord Shiva'. So, Sharvardhan can be translated as 'Lord Shiva's Abode'.
